# std::limits

Module file: `stdlib/std/limits.mla`

Integer limit helpers for MLang primitive integer types.

### Signed widths
- `i8_min() -> i8`
- `i8_max() -> i8`
- `i16_min() -> i16`
- `i16_max() -> i16`
- `i32_min() -> i32`
- `i32_max() -> i32`
- `i64_min() -> i64`
- `i64_max() -> i64`

### Unsigned widths
- `u8_min() -> u8`
- `u8_max() -> u8`
- `u16_min() -> u16`
- `u16_max() -> u16`
- `u32_min() -> u32`
- `u32_max() -> u32`
- `u64_min() -> u64`
- `u64_max() -> u64`

### Aliases
- `int_min() -> i32`
- `int_max() -> i32`
- `long_min() -> i64`
- `long_max() -> i64`
- `uint_min() -> u32`
- `uint_max() -> u32`
- `ulong_min() -> u64`
- `ulong_max() -> u64`

Example:

```rust
mod std::limits;

use std::limits::int_max;
use std::limits::i64_min;

let max_value: i32 = int_max();
let floor_value: i64 = i64_min();
```

See [`tests/std_limits_tests.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/std_limits_tests.mla).
